answers.workaround:
We can work around it for GDScript like this:

```
	var result := ""
	for global_class in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():
		if str(global_class["path"]) == script.resource_path:
			result = str(global_class["class"])
			break
```

<strike>However, that is only for `GDScript`. The method `get_global_name` exists in `Script`, and so it would also work for `CSharpScript` and any other future - or third party - derived class.</strike>
